data.long_description:
With only 147 villas in the entire community, this is currently the lowest-priced 5-bedroom villa available in Al Habtoor Polo Residences, while also offering one of the largest plots available directly from the developer—a combination that is exceptionally difficult to find in today's market.

 Key Highlights

•    Lowest-Priced 5-Bedroom Villa Currently Available in the Community
•    Largest Developer-Owned Plot Available at This Price Point
•    Directly from the Developer – Save AED 258,000 with No Buyer Commission
•    Many comparable villas are now offered through the resale market with a mandatory 2% buyer fee
•    Exceptional Opportunity for Renovation, Value Enhancement & Future Capital Appreciation
•    Built-Up Area: 4,763 sq.ft
•    Plot Size: 7,573 sq.ft
•    Comparable villas with plots of approximately 6,500 sq.ft are currently being offered at the same price, making this an exceptional value opportunity
•    Spacious layouts with generous indoor and outdoor living areas
•    Rental options also available from AED 350,000 per annum — experience the lifestyle first, with the option to purchase later
•    Arrange a private community tour, including a visit to the stables and an opportunity to experience the unique equestrian lifestyle firsthand

 Community Highlights

 •    Situated within the prestigious Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club
•    Access to luxury 5-star hotel and resort facilities
•    Four professional polo fields and world-class equestrian amenities
•    Riding school, stables, and horse-training facilities
•    Swimming pools, fitness centres, and wellness amenities
•    Fine dining restaurants, cafés, and leisure venues
•    Landscaped parks, walking trails, and expansive green spaces
•    Family-friendly environment with a strong sense of community

 Prime Location

 Ideally positioned with excellent connectivity to Dubai's key destinations, the community offers convenient access to major road networks, leading schools, business districts, shopping destinations, and entertainment hubs.

Privacy is luxury. Large plots are limited. Developer inventory is disappearing. Opportunities like this rarely come to market and are often the first to be secured.
Contact Adrian Bak, Community Expert, to arrange your private tour of Al Habtoor Polo Resort & Club.
